examples.chinese: 根據目前科學研究的資料，女性與男性在能力、態度和行為等方面的差異都非常小。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù mùqián kēxué yánjiū de zīliào, nǚxìng yǔ nánxìng zài nénglì, tàidù hé xíngwéi děng fāngmiàn de chāyì dōu fēicháng xiǎo.
examples.english: According to current scientific research data, the differences between women and men in aspects such as ability, attitude, and behavior are all very small.

examples.chinese: 我們無法控制別人的行為，卻能夠改變自己的想法。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen wúfǎ kòngzhì biérén de xíngwéi, què nénggòu gǎibiàn zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: We cannot control other people's behavior, but we can change our own thoughts.

examples.chinese: 為了安全起見，颱風天到山區露營的行為是被嚴格禁止的。
examples.pinyin: Wèile ānquán qǐjiàn, táifēng tiān dào shānqū lùyíng de xíngwéi shì bèi yángé jìnzhǐ de.
examples.english: For the sake of safety, camping in mountainous areas on typhoon days is strictly prohibited.

examples.chinese: 雖然他已經親自說了對不起，但還是很後悔做出那樣沒禮貌的行為，於是再度向各位道歉。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán tā yǐjīng qīnzì shuō le duìbuqǐ, dàn háishì hěn hòuhuǐ zuòchū nàyàng méi lǐmào de xíngwéi, yúshì zàidù xiàng gèwèi dàoqiàn.
examples.english: Although he has already personally said sorry, he still very much regrets having behaved so impolitely, so he once again apologizes to everyone.

examples.chinese: 重道德的人，即使在沒人看見的地方也會注意自己的行為。
examples.pinyin: Zhòng dàodé de rén, jíshǐ zài méi rén kànjiàn de dìfāng yě huì zhùyì zìjǐ de xíngwéi.
examples.english: A person who values morality will pay attention to their behavior even in places where no one is watching.

items.wordHook: Combining 行(walk) and 為(do): 行為 means behavior, conduct.

examples.chinese: 說到興趣，我們全家的興趣都不同，總是你玩你的，我做我的。
examples.pinyin: Shuō dào xìngqù, wǒmen quánjiā de xìngqù dōu bùtóng, zǒng shì nǐ wán nǐ de, wǒ zuò wǒ de.
examples.english: Speaking of interests, our whole family's interests are all different; it's always you play yours, and I do mine.

examples.chinese: 小年的夢想就是蓋一棟土地面積六十坪、三層樓高的房子，讓全家人都住在一起。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎonián de mèngxiǎng jiùshì gài yí dòng tǔdì miànjī liùshí píng, sān céng lóu gāo de fángzi, ràng quánjiā rén dōu zhù zài yìqǐ.
examples.english: Xiao Nian's dream is to build a three-story house with a land area of sixty ping, so that the whole family can live together.

examples.chinese: 華人在除夕那天，都要回到父母身邊，全家聚在一起吃年夜飯。
examples.pinyin: Huárén zài Chúxī nà tiān, dōu yào huídào fùmǔ shēnbiān, quánjiā jù zài yìqǐ chī niányèfàn.
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, Chinese people all return to their parents' side, and the whole family gathers together to eat the New Year's Eve dinner.

examples.chinese: 王太太把全家照顧得非常好，王先生很感謝她對家庭的貢獻。每個大學生畢業後，都應該為社會貢獻自己的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Wáng tàitai bǎ quánjiā zhàogù de fēicháng hǎo, Wáng xiānsheng hěn gǎnxiè tā duì jiātíng de gòngxiàn. Měi gè dàxuéshēng bìyè hòu, dōu yīnggāi wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn zìjǐ de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: Mrs. Wang takes very good care of the whole family; Mr. Wang is very grateful for her contribution to the family. After every university student graduates, they should contribute their professional abilities to society.

examples.chinese: 我們全家都是信基督教的，不論教會舉辦什麼活動，我們都一定去參加。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen quánjiā dōu shì xìn Jīdūjiào de, bùlùn jiàohuì jǔbàn shénme huódòng, wǒmen dōu yīdìng qù cānjiā.
examples.english: Our whole family is Christian; no matter what activities the church holds, we always go to participate.

examples.chinese: 麵包如果不想烤得太乾，可以在烤前噴點兒水。
examples.pinyin: Miànbāo rúguǒ bù xiǎng kǎo de tài gān, kěyǐ zài kǎo qián pēn diǎnr shuǐ.
examples.english: If you don't want the bread to be baked too dry, you can spray a little water before baking.

examples.chinese: 有人以為身體沒什麼毛病就代表很健康，這樣的想法事實上不完全正確。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén yǐwéi shēntǐ méi shénme máobìng jiù dàibiǎo hěn jiànkāng, zhèyàng de xiǎngfǎ shìshíshàng bù wánquán zhèngquè.
examples.english: Some people think that if the body has no problems, it means being very healthy; in fact, this idea is not entirely correct.

examples.chinese: 「了」這個詞的用法可以代表事情完成或情況改變。
examples.pinyin: 「le」 zhège cí de yòngfǎ kěyǐ dàibiǎo shìqíng wánchéng huò qíngkuàng gǎibiàn.
examples.english: The usage of the word 'le' can represent the completion of an action or a change in situation.

examples.chinese: 孔子不僅是中國偉大教師的代表，他的教育和哲學思想，對華人的影響也很大。
examples.pinyin: Kǒngzǐ bùjǐn shì Zhōngguó wěidà jiàoshī de dàibiǎo, tā de jiàoyù hé zhéxué sīxiǎng, duì Huárén de yǐngxiàng yě hěn dà.
examples.english: Confucius is not only a representative of China's great teachers, but his educational and philosophical thoughts have also had a great influence on Chinese people.

examples.chinese: 今天是我女兒十歲的生日，我在蛋糕上點上十根蠟燭，一根代表一歲。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shì wǒ nǚ'ér shí suì de shēngrì, wǒ zài dàngāo shàng diǎn shàng shí gēn làzhú, yī gēn dàibiǎo yī suì.
examples.english: Today is my daughter's tenth birthday; I lit ten candles on the cake, each one representing one year of age.

examples.chinese: 華人用十二生肖代表每一年。他常常代表學校去參加游泳比賽，所以在學校非常有名。
examples.pinyin: Huárén yòng shí'èr shēngxiào dàibiǎo měi yì nián. Tā chángcháng dàibiǎo xuéxiào qù cānjiā yóuyǒng bǐsài, suǒyǐ zài xuéxiào fēicháng yǒumíng.
examples.english: Chinese people use the twelve zodiac signs to represent each year. He often represents the school to participate in swimming competitions, so he is very famous at school.

examples.chinese: 華人用不一樣的動物代表每一年，一共有十二種動物。
examples.pinyin: Huárén yòng bù yíyàng de dòngwù dàibiǎo měi yì nián, yígòng yǒu shí'èr zhǒng dòngwù.
examples.english: Chinese use different animals to represent each year, and there are a total of twelve kinds of animals.

items.wordHook: 代(replace) + 表(show) → you show up in place of someone: 代表(to represent).

examples.chinese: 夏天到了，我們去海邊走走，順便去打個海灘排球。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān dào le, wǒmen qù hǎibiān zǒuzou, shùnbiàn qù dǎ ge hǎitān páiqiú.
examples.english: Summer has arrived; let's go for a walk by the beach and play some beach volleyball while we're at it.

items.wordHook: Combining 作(make) and 品(article): 作品 means work.
Reaching a top score of 十(ten) without any 分(divide) deduction indicates 十分(very, extremely).
a 女(woman) with a newborn 生(life) marks the family line → her 姓(surname).
a 十(ten) 早(early) light rests on a 韋(tanned leather) drum → the land of 韓(Korea).
